title: Run Bundle
description: A higher-level container that points at a Run record + event ledger + (optional) provider-specific trace + sandbox manifest + model/tools fingerprint + emitted artifacts. The bundle is the runtime-agnostic envelope: framework adapters (local_baseline, openai_agents, langgraph, modal_sandbox, ...) all emit bundles that the comparison harness reads through a single schema. The contract is portable on purpose: 'serialized resumable state' is referenced through trace_ref + sandbox_manifest_ref, not pinned to one vendor's RunState object name.

bundle_id.description: Stable identifier for the bundle. Conventionally `bundle-<sha8>` derived from canonical content. Distinct from run_id so the same run can be re-bundled with new adapter metadata.

run_id.description: The producer's run_id from the referenced Run record. Always carried verbatim, never synthesized.

runtime_adapter.description: Identifier for the adapter that produced this bundle. Conventional values: local_baseline, openai_agents, langgraph, modal_sandbox, google_adk, microsoft_agent_framework. Free-form so new adapters land without a schema bump.

adapter_version.description: Optional version string for the adapter (SDK version, internal release tag, etc.). Useful when comparing bundles across SDK upgrades.

generated_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp the bundle was emitted.

run_record_ref.description: Path or repo:// URI to the producer Run record JSON.

run_record_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the Run record bytes.

event_ledger_ref.description: Path or repo:// URI to the event ledger JSONL file.

event_ledger_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the event ledger bytes.

trace_ref.description: Optional path or repo:// URI to provider-specific trace data (e.g. OpenAI Agents SDK trace export, LangGraph state snapshot, Modal job log).

trace_hash.description: Optional SHA-256 of the trace file. Required when trace_ref is set.

sandbox_manifest_ref.description: Optional path or repo:// URI to a sandbox-manifest JSON capturing image / environment / mounted repo commit / allowed tools / network policy / timeout / budget. See sandbox-manifest.schema.json for the contract.

sandbox_manifest_hash.description: Optional SHA-256 of the sandbox-manifest file. Required when sandbox_manifest_ref is set.

model_tools_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the canonical (prompts + tool_schemas) snapshot for this run. Two bundles with the same fingerprint executed against the same prompt + tool surface; the field anchors cross-adapter equivalence checks.

artifacts.description: Outputs produced by the run. Each entry references one file by path or URI plus its SHA-256.

kind.description: Optional artifact kind: brief, eval-result, decision-record, code-patch, etc.

replay_status.description: Replay outcome for this bundle. pass: rehydration + re-run produced equivalent artifacts. investigate: drift detected; human review required. auto_rehydrate_blocked: the adapter refused to rehydrate (e.g. missing trace). auto_rehydrated: rehydrated automatically and verified. not_attempted: bundle emitted but never replayed (the default for fresh bundles).

replay_notes.description: Optional human-readable note on the replay outcome (e.g. which artifact diverged, which adapter step was non-deterministic).

cost_usage.description: Optional adapter-specific cost / usage record (tokens, dollars, sandbox seconds, etc.).
